LanguageData.SuffocationStrain.stages.1.label: alkalosis
LanguageData.SuffocationStrain.stages.2.label: respiratory failure

LanguageData.CombatEnduranceExhaust.description: Prolonged intense combat causes the nervous system to slide from overexcitement to exhaustion, affecting perception and emotional stability.

LanguageData.GoodSleep.label: good sleep
LanguageData.GoodSleep.description: Had sufficient quality sleep in a beautiful room. Feeling refreshed and more motivated to work.

LanguageData.PhysiqueStrainExhausted.stages.0.label: exhausted
